chapters.title: Graph ML for Risk Modeling: Reading Guide
chapters.description: Build a graph, turn relationships into evidence, and test whether that evidence survives a realistic deployment split.

chapters.title: Graph-Based Risk Modeling: Start with the Relationships
chapters.description: Build a typed application graph, distinguish strong and weak relations, and avoid turning shared infrastructure into guilt by association.

chapters.title: From Neighborhood Evidence to a Risk Score

chapters.description: Choose operating thresholds without test leakage, evaluate connected and unseen entities, and separate graph gains from investigation bias.
